task.title: Edit a setting detail
task.shortdesc: Apply or edit a Firefox policy or managed preference value from the All settings detail panel.

prereq.p: Open a setting detail panel for a supported editable value.

context.p: Detail editing keeps the change focused on one setting while reusing shared validation and save behavior.

step.cmd: Inspect the current value and validation state.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Enter or choose the new policy or managed preference value.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Apply the detail edit and watch for validation feedback.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Save the profile when the edited value is valid and intentional.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The selected policy or managed preference has the new value in the profile.

postreq.p: Recovery: if validation fails, correct the value shape or reset the detail before saving.
